visualCharacteristics.structure: vertical list of wide rows; photo on one side and text on the other, alternating sides every row
visualCharacteristics.numbering: large faint step number (1..n) behind the text, generated with CSS counters (not authored)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Numbered process/steps list (e.g. sustainability focus areas, subscription steps)

contentPattern.structure: one row per step; cell 1 = image, cell 2 = heading + paragraph(s), optional subheadings, lists and link. Step numbers and alternating image side come from CSS; authors never number or swap cells.
